title: A Future She Chooses (first full final proposal)

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The conversation is over, and Nerelle has not swum away. She rests one hand on the waterside stone.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “You have become good company, for a surface traveler. I do not award that lightly.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “My standards include knowing which end of a boat goes in the water.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Both ends, ideally.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “You are improving.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She laughs. Then her fin settles against the current, the way it does when she means to stay.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I need to say something before you say whatever you have been rehearsing.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “What if I haven’t rehearsed anything?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Then this will be our most efficient conversation yet.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I have spoken with the people responsible for my duties. Some of the work, I will share.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “The duties that are mine, I will keep. And I will go on exploring the surface waterways whenever I wish.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “How did that go?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “There were many documents. Three council members went noticeably grayer. I counted.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “We will disagree, sometimes. Some days my people will need me. Some days I will need quiet.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “None of that makes me want a life with you any less.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I will not leave the ocean to become someone’s idea of a proper bride.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “And I will not ask you to give up your life and call it devotion.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Then what do you want?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “A partnership. Honest plans. Places to meet where the water reaches the shore. Room to keep learning.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She reaches up from the water and offers her hand, the way one head of state offers it to another.

options.labelText: “I love your curiosity, your care for people, and that you know your own mind. Your future’s yours. Marry me, and we’ll build it together?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You really heard every word.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I tried. I’ll probably need reminders.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Good. I have already prepared several. They are in alphabetical order.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She looks out at the tide for a moment. It keeps moving. Then she turns back to you.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Yes, {PLAYER}.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “The ocean is still my home. My duties are still real. And there is room for us, if we keep making it.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I don’t know every part of what comes next.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Neither do I. I used to think that meant I had failed to plan.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “And now?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Now I think it means we write a few pages together. In waterproof ink.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes your hand across the waterside stone. Hers is cold from the water, and does not let go.

options.labelText: “Marry me, and I’ll find a spell to give you legs. Then none of this has to be complicated.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Legs?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “So we could live together on land.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You heard me tell you who I am. Then you answered with a plan to change it.”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “I thought it would make things easier.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Easier for whom?”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She does not say yes. Her hand goes back under the water, though she does not swim away.

options.labelText: “I’ll give up everything above the water for you. We’ll never have to think about the surface again.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “You would give up your whole life because you think I need you to?”

branch.speaker: PLAYER
branch.text: “Isn’t that what devotion is?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Not to me. I do not want a love that only works if one of us disappears.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: The tide moves between the quay stones. She says no, and leaves room for you to ask again.
